title: Ten weeks in Belgium and run-ins with King Farouk over beer
summary: At the coast resort he refused champagne offered by King Farouk, who also phoned him at ten a.m. to join him at his cabana; locals held Jonah Jones parties and asked about Jackie Robinson and segregation.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: But all the records I did over there, and when I got paid, I just sent it to Belgium because I was going there anyway, so I did that. And when we got to Belgium, we stayed there 10 weeks. It was nice, beautiful. With this same band, Andre Rialte, and Guy Leon was playing the trumpet, and we had a wonderful time. And I met King Farouk there and we had a big argument with him about the -- he wanted me to have champagne. The waiter came and said, 'The King would like for you to have a drink.' And I didn't even know him. He said have a drink with him, so I said okay. I was drinking that Heineken's over there, so I said a draft, so he said okay, and I went over there and I said, 'Bring me a glass of Heineken's.' He said, 'Heineken's? Bring him champagne.' I said, 'I don't want no champagne. I drink beer, you know.' He said, 'Oh, beer. Champagne.' I said, 'Look, you asked me to have a drink. You want me to have a drink.' The waiter said, 'Go ahead and have champagne. That's King Farouk.' I said, 'I don't care who he is. I drink beer. I don't drink champagne. I've got another show to do.' So he said, 'Okay, bring him beer.' So

he brought me a thing of beer, you know, and then the next day he called me at the hotel about 10:00 o'clock in the morning. Another run-in. I said, "Who is this?" I don't get up till about 1:00, you know. So he said, "This is Farouk." I said, "What do you want, man, at this time of the morning?" He said, "I've got a cabana down here," on the thing. Wanted me to come down and get some sun and everything. I said, "I'll be down about 2:00 o'clock." He said, "No, come down now." I said, "No, uh-uh. I can't come down until 1:00 o'clock." So then I told the lady, I said, "Don't wake me up till 1:00 o'clock. That goes for every day, you know." Mrs. Simmons. She was nice woman. And I went down about 2:00 o'clock. He had the cabana there and he had me a little keg of beer, sitting in the bucket of ice. And I really enjoyed that gig, you know, and people got so they liked me around there, was giving parties, a little town, you know. And people would give a party for me, a Jonah Jones party, you know. I met people and got real intimate with them, and they wanted to know about Jackie Robinson, and why didn't they allow you to play baseball in America, you know. And I said, "They played baseball but they had their own leagues," and Jackic is not the first to play baseball. He's the first to get in the American Leagues, you know, to integrate it. So you have to go through all of that with them, because they want to know about all of that.
